text:
Jon Rivera: Hi folks — planning to relocate from UK to Dublin on Aug 2. Quick checklist: payroll transfer, WFH stipend proration, and whether this creates an Irish tax/nexus issue for Redwood?
People Ops: Congrats! :tada: Steps: 1) Fill homebase change form, 2) upload proof of address + PPSN, 3) send bank details.
Payroll-APAC-Bot: Note: Payroll vendor: GlobalPay EU. Cutoff to switch payroll for Aug run: Jul 20. To guarantee Aug on Irish payroll submit docs by Jul 10. Required: passport, PPSN, bank IBAN.
People Ops: WFH stipend prorated on 30-day month. If you move Aug 2, Aug stipend will be prorated (days on UK payroll vs IE payroll). Currency follows payroll run.
Jon Rivera: Any risk of forming a tax presence if I'm the only person in IE? I occasionally meet customers in EU.
Legal-Team: Single remote headcount usually doesn't automatically require entity registration. Nexus depends on local activities (sales, contracting, local hiring). If you will negotiate contracts or have frequent customer-facing in-country presence, we should run an assessment. For now proceed with the homebase change and we'll monitor.
Benefits-Team: Ireland social/health coverage aligns with payroll. We can assist with enrollment once PPSN provided. Temporary private cover available if needed.
People Ops: Action items for Jon: submit form, DM docs to People Ops, cc manager. We'll open a ticket and loop Legal + Payroll. Expect ticket number in 24h.
Jon Rivera: Thanks 609 filing now.
People Ops: Ping here if any delays — we'll support the transition.
